purpose: Define resilient worker retry behavior and post-expiry detection when expected work history fails to return to Master Records.

derived_postures.HEALTHY: Expected worker return is present and canonically recorded.
derived_postures.RETRYING: Worker remains within bounded resilience attempts before expiry/return expectation is violated.
derived_postures.RETURN_PENDING: Worker work has not yet reached the governed expiry/return expectation point.
derived_postures.RETURN_OVERDUE: Expected return is past due and no matching Master Records record exists.
derived_postures.WORKER_NONREPORT: Independent observation confirms the worker return obligation was not fulfilled.
derived_postures.RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED: Conflicting or partial evidence prevents a safe determination.
derived_postures.UNKNOWN: No sufficient bound expectation/evidence exists to classify.

observer_roles.StegIndex: Resolve expected worker/task/history relationships and identify unmatched expected-return identities.
observer_roles.StegDB: Compare durable monitoring/index records and Master Records intake/recording state for missing or stale returns.
observer_roles.StegHealth: Classify ecosystem/task health consequences of overdue or missing worker returns and surface repair/escalation needs.
